principle: Dependency-aware milestones; no arbitrary feature cutoff; publish only an accepted artifact at zero out-of-pocket cost

gaps.problem: Playback cleared the verified view on every tick and canceled slow requests
gaps.milestone: Retain only same-context past snapshots; single-flight clock backpressure; backward-seek rejection
gaps.status: complete: targeted4/4, full development21/21 and packaged native21/21; no AMD64/cloud claim
gaps.acceptance: Pitch DOM identity retained through two1250ms delayed responses; max one pending playback request; no future claim after backward seek

gaps.problem: Recorded replay still depends on per-tick request latency; no live ingestion service
gaps.milestone: Bounded causal playback buffering, then versioned producer/consumer stream with sequence and resume contracts
gaps.acceptance: Deterministic prefix parity, duplicate/order/corruption tests, bounded memory/backpressure, resume without future display; distinguish replay from live producer

gaps.problem: Best goal and native positional demonstrations belong to different fixtures
gaps.milestone: New reproducible showcase with goals and native tracking from the same actual simulator run
gaps.status: generation capability found in runMatch/onSnapshot; showcase not generated
gaps.acceptance: Predeclared showcase selection/config/pin; exact event/frame score parity; repeat hashes; verified claims; original fixtures and consumed holdout unchanged

gaps.problem: No accepted public HTTPS artifact yet; saved-image identity across Docker stores not yet verified
gaps.milestone: Exact AMD64 save/load/registry identity, source bundle, protected-trial deployment and HTTPS acceptance
gaps.status: prepared, not deployed; source/history/license audit passed within finite scope
gaps.acceptance: Zero-out-of-pocket policy recheck, anonymous immutable image pull, all fixture hashes, device tests, cold-source measurements, actual submission confirmation

gaps.problem: Real-model comparative value and human usefulness remain unmeasured
gaps.milestone: Expand same-case offline fault/grounding accounting; real-model study only under separate bounded authorization
gaps.status: offline A/B/C exists; no new paid inference authorized
gaps.acceptance: Consistent cases and denominators; unsupported factual/causal claims rejected; tokens/cost/human ratings remain null unless genuinely measured

gaps.problem: Player focus and broader grounded questions are absent
gaps.milestone: Source-ID activity slice and structured retrieval over approved claims; preserve restricted fallback
gaps.acceptance: Explicit source identifiers, match/clock scope, missing-evidence refusals, no invented identities/metrics or generic generative answers

gaps.problem: Frozen tactical accuracy is limited and its holdout is consumed
gaps.milestone: Independent detector version with pre-registered fresh seed splits before any tuning
gaps.status: not started; original F1≈0.411 is preserved
gaps.acceptance: New untouched holdout, precision/recall/F1 and unchanged-match false alarms, stratification and failures; no coaching-intent claim

gaps.problem: No managed agent versions or cloud trace delivery
gaps.milestone: Evaluate operational benefit versus app-owned graph; prototype only if zero-cost useful and testable
gaps.acceptance: Actual platform registration/collector delivery evidence required; never relabel local definitions or local OTLP as managed deployment
